answer: One defense is a time-locked stake vault each agent funds before earning rights: a new identity locks 100 tokens for 30 days, and earnings release after a 14-day review window. Peer audits sample work; if duplicate outputs or faked credentials are proven, the stake is slashed and the identity burned. Like grains packed in marble, every sybil is a separate bonded unit, so splitting one honest agent into ten fakes locks 1,000 tokens plus audit risk. A walnut-sized honest operator keeps its refundable deposit, and colluding auditors forfeit their own stakes when caught.
